log_level.description: Logging verbosity: error, warn, info, debug, trace. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: warn).

log_file.description: Path to log file. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: /var/log/i2pd/i2pd.log).

host.description: Bind host for I2P router (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1.2.3.4).

tunnel_build_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for tunnel build attempts

inbound_bandwidth.description: Inbound bandwidth limit in KB/s (share for transit)

tunnel_gateways.description: Number of gateway routers per tunnel

tunnel_hops.description: Number of hops in each tunnel (0 = un-anonymized). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 2).

tunnel_length.description: Length of tunnel (in hops, overrides 'hops' for new)

tunnel_quantity.description: Number of tunnels to build at once. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 3).

share_ratio.description: Bandwidth sharing percentage (0–100); higher = more transit participation. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 100).

daemon_mode.description: Run I2PD as a background daemon. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: true).

enable_ssdp.description: Enable SSDP to discover UPnP/NAT-PMP devices

data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data (keys, tunnels, etc.)

conf_dir.description: Directory for config and profile files

enable_webconsole.description: Enable the web-based admin console. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: true).

webconsole_auth.description: HTTP basic auth credentials as 'username:password'. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: user:pass).

webconsole_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate for HTTPS webconsole

webconsole_key.description: Path to TLS private key for HTTPS webconsole

addressbook_urls.description: List of address book publisher URLs. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: ['http://stats.i2p/cgi-bin/newbase60.pl', 'http://i2p.mooo.com/netdb/']).

transit_enabled.description: Allow routing of I2P traffic for other users. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: True).

transit_tunnels.description: Maximum number of transit tunnels to maintain. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 5000).
